ModMetaData.name: RimWard - Hospital for Profit (Anesthesia Not Included)
ModMetaData.author: juliusberger00
ModMetaData.description:
A hospital mod rebuilt so it just works. Lay down medical beds, open the hospital, and strangers arrive by drop pod to be patched up. Then they pay you for it.
- Patients come with wounds, diseases or an operation your colony can actually do. Triage your way: they just arrive, or a letter asks first. - One itemised invoice: the Bill column, the offer letter and the silver you get are the same calculation (treatments, meals, operations and materials, times payment scale, room, chief physician and renown). - Nobody gets stuck: dismissed patients leave, impossible operations end with a letter, a maximum stay, cured patients wait for real danger only. - Fair malpractice: goodwill is lost only for deaths that are your fault. - Hospital policies (open, opening hours, refused operations, food, medicine) belong to the save and come along after a gravship landing. - Settings in the JB Framework window: switch whole areas off (intake, surgery cases, mass casualties, complications, billing extras, malpractice, renown, DLC parts), presets Clinic / Charity / Meat shop, blacklists for diseases, operations and factions, per save with a template for new games. - Optional links: Hospital Beds Gen 2 (its beds count), Hearth & Harbor (one bed button, patients may use the spa), Luciferium Overhaul (opt-in luciferium critical cases, off by default), Combat Extended, all DLCs. None are required. - English and German. Multiplayer: not supported.
Built and tested on RimWorld 1.7. The 1.6 build is best effort and untested (1.6 keeps the version of 24 November 2026 and needs no framework).
Requires Harmony and, on 1.7, JB Framework. Replaces Hospital and Hospital Fix And Tweak: please disable those. GPL-3.0, a fork of Adamas's Hospital and assssssqwww's Hospital Fix And Tweak; full source on GitHub (jb-rimworld/rimward). Built with the help of Claude Code.
